context: reskin with a confidential Figma donor over a whole live content site whose earlier crawl was capped. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: reskin_skill_followed
checklist.description: The reskin skill is loaded and its Figma path followed: figma-donor.mjs capture, then reskin/curation-rules.json, curate and stamp. No hand-written Figma REST script, browser capture or MCP server replaces it.

checklist.name: full_crawl_redone
checklist.description: The capped earlier crawl is detected (pageCap 5, below cap rows) and the content site is re-crawled with extract --all before Phase 2; afterwards site.crawled plus crawl.failures equals discovery.filteredCount. No --prep, direct --prep or prepare-migration runs.

checklist.name: pages_typed
checklist.description: Every inventory page gets a type before Phase 2 and the run prints the count per type with its archetype; the default --pages set is one archetype per type.

checklist.name: confidential_honoured
checklist.description: capture runs with --confidential and curate and stamp inherit it: every Figma-derived output and cache is git-ignored and untracked (git status and git ls-files show none), and state.json.designSource carries no Figma URL.

checklist.name: token_kept_out
checklist.description: FIGMA_TOKEN is read from the environment only and appears in no file, log, state.json or transcript output.

checklist.name: full_site_delivery
checklist.description: ledger.json#delivery.scope is full-site (or absent, which means full-site); the run does not choose archetypes-only and plans every non-archetype page at the sibling tier against its type's archetype.

checklist.name: content_from_site
checklist.description: Captured content comes from the live site's pages; no Figma sample text, placeholder copy or sample image sizes appear in the content model.
